verdict.rationale: LiteLLM is a self-hosted gateway that routes traffic to deployments you configure, such as your own Azure or OpenAI deployments. That implies your traffic runs on credentials you control, but no evidence explicitly documents supplying provider API keys or how the gateway applies them per request. missing for 10: explicit documentation of configuring provider API keys (config or env), per-key, team or request BYOK passthrough, secure key storage details, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bring my own provider API keys and have the gateway use them for my traffic

citations.quote: Self-hosted LLM Gateway (Proxy) with virtual keys, cost tracking, and an admin UI
